title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

If you love turning inefficient, manual workflows into elegant, well-integrated systems - and you know how to bring stakeholders along for the ride - this is your kind of role.

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future

 
 
 

About the Role

 

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It is the foundation and lifeblood of our product, the core that unlocks the power of the energy markets for our customers, turning a complex challenge into a source of savings and sustainability.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Data Intelligence team. This high-impact team builds and operates the utility backbone of our energy platform, combining expertise in data platforms, data engineering, and business intelligence. You will own the technical direction for these critical systems, which include everything from metering data management to our invoicing and billing services.

You'll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, creating an environment where engineers thrive and do their best work. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will lead an established and growing group of talented engineers.

At trawa, our culture is generally "office-first with flexibility", where most of us are in our beautiful Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to occasionally work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, spending minimum 3 days a week in the office.

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform that our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the key processes of an energy provider including timeseries data management, invoicing and billing services.

Our tech stack

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Conduct a review of the team's operational health and technical debt, presenting a prioritized plan for improvement in areas like observability, data health, and platform scalability

  • Define and share a clear vision and strategic roadmap for the Data Intelligence team

  • In partnership with key stakeholders across the business, define and finalize the team's roadmap for the upcoming quarter, aligning it with company OKRs and communicating the plan broadly

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • You have at least two years of experience in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • You know how to lead teams, balance competing priorities, and create an environment where engineers do their best work.

  • You have hands-on experience building or leading a scalable data platform, and can confidently drive architecture decisions around pipelines, data modelling, and analytics infrastructure.

  • Clear communicator who builds trust and fosters collaboration across teams and with non-technical stakeholders.Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds and experiences can thrive.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

 
 
 

Why Join Us

You will also take part in cross‑department leadership development initiatives that help you collaborate, learn and grow alongside other leaders across trawa. You will be supported by experienced mentors and colleagues who want to see you succeed and make a meaningful impact across the organisation.

 

Ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

Learning and Growth - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

Package and Benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Operations & Automation Engineer – Renewable Energy
description:
Operations & Automation Engineer – Renewable Supply

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen – und baue als Operations & Automation Engineer skalierbare Prozesse und Automatisierungslösungen auf, die trawa beim Wachstum unterstützen. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie. Wir kombinieren Energiebelieferung, fortschrittliche Energiemanagement-Software und intelligente Optimierung von Verbrauch und Flexibilitäten, damit Unternehmen in einem volatilen Energiemarkt erfolgreich bleiben und ihre Dekarbonisierung beschleunigen.

Als Operations & Automation Engineer startest du im Customer Support – nicht weil Support deine Endstation ist, sondern weil direkter Kundenkontakt der beste Weg ist, zu verstehen, wo Automatisierung den größten Unterschied macht. Du entwickelst unseren KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilot weiter, baust die dafür nötige Tooling-Landschaft auf und erweiterst deinen Wirkungskreis Schritt für Schritt auf den gesamten Ops-Bereich. Dein Ziel: manuelle und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu reduzieren und trawa dadurch effizienter, schneller und skalierbarer zu machen.

Als Operations & Automation Engineer übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • Weiterentwicklung des Customer Support-Agenten: Du bist Owner unseres KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilots – von der Anforderungsdefinition über die technische Weiterentwicklung bis zur Integration in unsere Tooling-Landschaft (Velaris, Airtable, HubSpot). Du treibst die Automatisierung von Ticket-Assignment, Lösungsvorschlägen und Kundenkommunikation aktiv voran.

  • Customer Support als Lernvehikel: Du bearbeitest selbst eingehende Kundenanfragen – per Telefon und E-Mail – um ein tiefes Verständnis für wiederkehrende Probleme, Edge Cases und Prozesslücken zu entwickeln. Dieses Wissen fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung des Agenten und der Knowledge Base ein.

  • Ownership der Tooling-Landschaft: Du evaluierst, implementierst und entwickelst die Tools weiter, die unser Ops-Team braucht – von dedizierten Ticketing-Systemen bis hin zu Automatisierungsplattformen. Du erkennst, wo aktuelle Tools an ihre Grenzen stoßen, und treibst die Einführung von Alternativen voran.

  • Automatisierung im gesamten Ops-Bereich: Customer Support ist der Anfang. Gemeinsam mit angrenzenden Teams – Finance, Onboarding, Customer Success – identifizierst du weitere Automatisierungspotenziale, entwickelst Lösungen und hilfst so, Automatisierung bei trawa Schritt für Schritt weiter auszubauen.

  • Stakeholder Management & kontinuierliche Iteration: Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, holst Feedback ein, priorisierst Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass Automatisierungslösungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern auch genutzt und stetig verbessert werden.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil unseres Business Operations Teams – mit Funktionen wie Onboarding, Customer Support und Customer Success darunter. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir daran, Prozesse im gesamten Ops-Bereich effizienter zu machen und Automatisierung dort einzusetzen, wo sie den größten Unterschied macht. Du gestaltest diesen Weg aktiv mit – als Querschnittsfunktion, die nah an den Problemen ist und pragmatische Lösungen entwickelt.

Nach wem wir suchen:

  • Frisch von der Uni oder mit erster relevanter Erfahrung – wichtiger als Berufserfahrung ist ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und der Antrieb, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen

  • Technologieaffinität auf einem anderen Level: Du hast bereits mit Automatisierungstools, APIs, KI-Agenten oder ähnlichem gearbeitet – oder brennst darauf, es zu tun

  • Ausgeprägte Eigenverantwortung und Gründlichkeit: Du verlierst keine Aufgabe aus den Augen, priorisierst souverän und lieferst zuverlässig

  • Starkes Prozessverständnis: Du erkennst schnell, wo manuelle Arbeit durch Automatisierung ersetzt werden kann, und weißt, wie du das strukturiert umsetzt

  • Exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und hands-on Mentalität: Du gehst professionell und lösungsorientiert auf Kund:innen sowie interne Teams ein und packst Probleme selbst an

  • Einfallsreichtum und Eigeninitiative: Wenn du eine Lösung nicht kennst, findest du sie – durch Research, Experimentieren oder den direkten Austausch mit Kolleg:innen

  • Interesse am komplexen Energiemarkt und Bereitschaft, dich in die Welt der erneuerbaren Energien einzuarbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachlerniveau sowie fließendes Englisch

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

  • Monat 1: Du tauchst in trawas Ops-Welt ein – Produkte, Prozesse, Tools und Kundenkontakt. Du bearbeitest erste eigene Kundenanfragen, um ein echtes Verständnis für wiederkehrende Probleme und Prozesslücken zu entwickeln. Gleichzeitig machst du dich mit dem bestehenden Customer Support-Agenten vertraut und verstehst, wo er heute an seine Grenzen stößt.

  • Monat 2: Du übernimmst die Ownership des Customer Support-Agenten und bringst erste konkrete Verbesserungen ein – in der Knowledge Base, im Automatisierungsgrad und in der Tool-Integration. Du evaluierst, ob die aktuelle Tooling-Landschaft die Zielversion des Agenten unterstützen kann, und entwickelst einen klaren Fahrplan für die nächsten Schritte.

  • Monat 3 und danach: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung des Agenten end-to-end und hast erste Automatisierungen live gebracht, die dem Team messbar Zeit sparen. Du blickst über den Customer Support hinaus, identifizierst die nächsten Automatisierungspotenziale im Ops-Bereich und beginnst, trawa's Fähigkeiten im Bereich Automatisierung systematisch aufzubauen.

Warum wir?

  • Dein Impact: Du treibst bei trawa aktiv voran, wie wir Prozesse automatisieren und den gesamten Ops-Bereich effizienter machen – eine zentrale Voraussetzung dafür, dass trawa skalieren kann. Dein Beitrag ist direkt spür- und messbar.

  • Office First Kultur: Unser schönes Office in Berlin Mitte ist das Herz unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir leben eine Kultur, in der wir als Team vor Ort wirken, voneinander lernen und Geschwindigkeit aufnehmen – das ist uns sehr wichtig. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen unserer Office-First-Kultur und 30 Urlaubstagen unterstützen wir dich – ob für Familie, persönliche Projekte oder Erholung.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, steuerfreie Extras und eine Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Arbeite mit modernen Tools und lerne von Branchenexpert:innen. Wir bieten dir Weiterbildungstage, ein jährliches L&D-Budget und Coaching-Sessions über Sparrks.

  • Vielfalt & Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen – wir engagieren uns für einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz, der Vielfalt wertschätzt durch Angebote wie Mitarbeiter:innen- und Diversity-Netzwerke. Daher ermutigen wir Menschen unterschiedlichen Geschlechts, Alters, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit und körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Bereit zu gestalten?

Wenn du operativ stark bist, technisch denkst und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft.

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

title: Solutions Engineer | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the software that powers the electronics supply chain — and we're building out the DACH side of our Global Solutions team. As a Solutions Engineer based in Munich or Berlin, you are the technical face of Luminovo at the two moments that decide whether a customer succeeds with us.

The Solutions team is one global team across Europe and the US, deliberately not split by region so knowledge doesn't get siloed. It's a unified team, which means real ownership: you won't inherit a finished playbook, you'll help write it.

What you'll do

  • Join AE- and CSM-led sales calls as the technical expert — run tailored demos, technical deep dives, and ROI cases for OEM and EMS prospects, then hand back for the commercial close

  • Own customer onboarding end to end: tenant configuration, ERP and data integrations, end-user training, and driving each account to first value

  • Bring structure into chaos. When an implementation drifts or a customer gets lost, you're the person who rebuilds the plan and gets them back on track

  • Become the go-to expert for at least one Luminovo module, define its onboarding blueprint, and teach the rest of the Solutions team how to run it

  • Build deep expertise in the Luminovo platform and the electronics manufacturing landscape — deep enough that industry experts trust you in the room

  • Spot implementation risk early, escalate to the right people proactively, and keep projects on schedule

  • Turn what you learn into revenue-anchored feature requests and input for the Product team helping them to further improve our software.

Who you are

  • You speak German fluently and work comfortably in English. You'll be in front of technical buyers every week

  • You have a technical foundation and a track record of getting deep into an unfamiliar product fast. A degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or a related field helps — so does hard evidence that you taught yourself something difficult

  • You're process-driven. You're at your best when a project has gone sideways and someone needs to draw the map

  • You're comfortable in front of customers: you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a specialist, then explain the same thing simply to a procurement lead

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. Ideally you've built your own automations, workflows, or tools — we care about what you've actually shipped, not what you've read them

  • Bonus: French language fluency

Work setup

Hybrid in Munich or Berlin. Munich is our global HQ; we also have a Berlin hub. No strict office policy, but a clear expectation of regular collaboration days with your Solutions teammates and colleagues across multiple departments.

Travel

We meet regularly for team retreats and selected industry events, so expect occasional travel. We cover the costs.

Why Luminovo

  • Join a well-funded SaaS scale-up with 300+ active customers, in the role that decides whether they succeed with us

  • One global Solutions team across Europe and the US — no EU/US knowledge silos

  • AI at the core of the product and of how we work, not a slide in a deck

  • Real ownership on a young team: define the blueprints the rest of the team runs on

🤓 Whom you'll be working with

  • Rachel, Global Solutions

  • Sam, Global Solutions

  • Seba, one of our founders, close to our OEM and go-to-market motion

  • Our Account Executives and Customer Success Managers across DACH, who'll pull you into their most technical conversations

  • Our Product Managers, so you understand the roadmap and constraints and can feed real customer signal back into it

⚡️ Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

 

Compensation: €73K – €107.7K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • Multiple Ranges

  • DACH - Tier 2 • On-Target Earnings €73K – €84K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission
  • DACH - Tier 3 • On-Target Earnings €93.5K – €107.7K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our product team. We hire senior PMs at the company level and place you where your strengths and our biggest bets meet - the revenue-cycle workflows practices run every day, the data and integration platform beneath them, our financial products, or the AI agents now working across all of it.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own a product domain end to end: its strategy, metrics and roadmap, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Run mixed-method discovery and turn it into sharp, sequenced bets you can defend

  • Proactively find the problems worth solving in and around your domain, size them, and build the case to prioritise them

  • Drive prioritisation and delivery with engineering and design — the trade-offs, the milestones, the scope calls

  • Hold an end-to-end model of your domain and be a credible partner to engineering on it

  • Build alignment across functions and with leadership.

What you'll bring:

  • Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

  • Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

  • Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

  • Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to engineering

  • You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly - so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product. As building gets cheaper, deciding what to build well becomes the job

  • Experience in data-heavy environments: data products, pipelines, and instrumentation you treat as first-class

    Strong communication. You cut complexity for any audience, including leadership, and hold alignment across teams

    5+ years of product management experience

    Professional fluency in German (C1+) and English. You'll work with practices, partners and internal teams in both, every day.

Even better if you have:

  • Built and shipped AI products and not just used AI tools, but shaped how a product learns and improves (evaluation, feedback loops, agent and tool design)

  • Worked with financial or payment products, and the regulatory and risk questions that come with them

  • Built or owned interfaces with external partners and providers — the APIs, integrations and third-party relationships they require

  • Built B2B SaaS in a regulated or less-digital vertical, healthcare especially.

Our Interview Process:

  • Recruiter screen - get the know Nelly

  • Product craft interview with one of our Product Managers

  • Case study interview with hiring manager

  • Office visit - interviews with stakeholders and product

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation

  • A dog-friendly office with great vibes and a team that's fun to work with

  • Snacks and a fridge full of cold drinks

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move.

As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better.

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs.

What you will do

  • Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends.

  • Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners.

  • Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly.

  • Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on.

  • Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production.

  • Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback.

  • Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might

  • Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails.

  • Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes.

  • Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own.

  • Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you.

  • A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must.

  • You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:

title: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

You are part of our revenue team and actively drive the new customer pipeline. You independently build relationships with potential clients, qualify accounts, and turn market potential into concrete sales opportunities. With a data-driven and performance-oriented approach, you directly shape the growth of RobCo in Germany and make a significant contribution to the team’s success.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contact Specialist:
    You initiate first contact with potential customers and identify the right decision-makers.

  • Sales Professional:
    You generate new sales opportunities and work strategically within a dynamic marketing landscape.

  • Relationship Manager:
    You build and maintain relationships in line with RobCo’s Operating Principles and ensure a smooth handover to the Field Sales team.

  • Team Player:
    You collaborate closely with other departments and support our campaigns to optimize the overall sales strategy.

We're looking for someone who has:

description:

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

Requirements

  • Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

  • Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

  • Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision

  • Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house

  • Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.

  • Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.

  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.

  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch

As Junior Solution Architect you will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders and will report to your Solution Architect Team Lead. We are looking for someone who is passionate about hardware and software products, enjoys solving problems, and is excited to grow into a trusted technical advisor role. You will be working in an experienced Presales team and support sales in the deal process as well as linking ideas with our product and engineering team. You will have direct contact with customers and reselling partners to transfer knowledge and to help build and develop relationships and sales opportunities.


Your profile

We're looking for someone who brings:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial/mechanical Engineering, Logistics Technology or comparable education or work experience
  • Ability to communicate technical topics clearly to different audiences and eagerness to further develop this skill
  • A broad interest in information technology topics, ideally in mobile solutions, enterprise software, warehousing, logistics or industrial environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoyment of working in structured yet dynamic situations
  • Proactiveness, curiosity, and motivation to learn from experienced colleagues and real customer scenarios
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites, partner locations and company events
  • Business fluency in German and English; additional languages are a plus
Nice-to-Have
  • Initial professional experience, internships, or academic project exposure in pre-sales, solution engineering, technical consulting, IT systems, or software/hardware environments
  • Experience in a logistics or industrial work environment 
  • Basic scripting or programming experience (e.g. Python, JavaScript, SQL) is a plus.


Why us?

At ProGlove, we build technology that helps frontline workers perform at their best.

We're a global team that combines innovation with execution. We move quickly, stay close to our customers and focus on solving real-world challenges that create meaningful impact.

We believe in taking ownership, learning through action and working together to achieve ambitious goals. Ideas are welcomed, initiative is valued and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution at ProGlove.

What you can expect:

Grow with purpose

  • Dedicated learning time during working hours
  • Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues
  • Exposure to real industrial customers

Work with flexibility

  • Flexible working hours
  • Modern tools and technology to help you do your best work

Be part of something meaningful

  • Help shape technology used by global industry leaders
  • Work in an international, collaborative environment
  • Share ideas, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact

Benefits

  • Employee referral program
  • Comprehensive health and wellbeing programs
  • Team events and company gatherings


What success looks like

In your first 12 months you will:

Support customer success

  • Participate in customer workshops, discovery sessions and technical discussions
  • Help understand customer processes, technical environments and business challenges
  • Support product demonstrations, onboarding activities and technical training
  • Assist with Proof of Concepts, pilots and customer rollouts
  • Build trusted relationships through responsiveness and a strong customer-first mindset

Contribute to solution design

  • Support the design of scalable customer solutions
  • Prepare demo environments and technical documentation
  • Help validate customer environments and implementation requirements
  • Assist with technical troubleshooting alongside senior colleagues
  • Document learnings and contribute to best practices

 Collaborate across teams

  • Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Customer Success and Engineering
  • Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements
  • Share customer feedback to help improve our products
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and continuous improvement

Grow every day

As you develop your technical and customer-facing skills, you will gradually take ownership of more complex solution design and customer engagements, with the opportunity to grow into a Solution Architect role.


Meet your team

You’ll join our experienced Presales team and work closely with Solution Architects who will help you build your technical and customer-facing skills. Together, you’ll support Sales in customer conversations, demonstrations and solution design. You’ll also collaborate with Product, Engineering and Customer Success to turn customer needs into solutions that work in practice.

title: Werkstudent:in Operations & Customer Experience
description:
nuuEnergy - Das sind WIR!

nuuEnergy hat es sich zur Mission gemacht, die Wärmewende anzuführen, die Europa dringend braucht!

Du willst nicht Kaffee kochen, sondern sehen, wie ein Climate-Tech-Startup von innen funktioniert? Wir suchen Dich als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund:innen, den Montageteams in unseren Hubs und dem Team in der Zentrale. Du löst Probleme, planst Einsätze und baust die Prozesse mit auf, mit denen wir in den nächsten Jahren wachsen.

Klingt spannend? Dann lies weiter!

Über uns

Wir sind ein Climate-Tech-Start-up aus München und revolutionieren Wärmepumpeninstallationen: mit smarten End-to-End-Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen, ehrlichem Handwerk, regionalen Teams und Anlagen, die wirklich funktionieren.

Was heißt das genau? 
Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für Wärmepumpen-Standorte in ganz Deutschland. Unsere regionalen Standorte („Hubs“) installieren Wärmepumpen bei Hausbesitzer:innen; Prozesse, Kundenakquise, Recruiting und eigene Software kommen zentral aus unserem HQ in München.

Was uns besonders macht? 
Unsere Kombination aus Start-up-Dynamik, Handwerksstolz und echter Sinnhaftigkeit. Wir haben ein starkes Führungsteam, viele Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und vergeben Verantwortung ab Tag 1.


Deine Aufgaben

Warum es diese Rolle gibt:
Mit jeder Wärmepumpe, die wir installieren, wächst die Zahl unserer Kundinnen und Kunden, die auch nach der Installation gut betreut werden wollen. Rückfragen, Wartungen, kleine Störungen: Wie wir damit umgehen, entscheidet, ob jemand uns weiterempfiehlt.
Deshalb bauen wir hier unsere operativen Prozesse weiter aus.
Du bist am Kundentelefon die erste Ansprechperson, sorgst dafür, dass Wartungstermine zuverlässig geplant werden, und findest heraus, wo unsere Serviceprozesse noch haken. Die Ausführung vor Ort übernehmen unsere Handwerksteams in den Hubs. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen und machst den Ablauf Schritt für Schritt besser.

Was du bei uns lernst

  • Wie ein Unternehmen mit mehreren Standorten operativ gesteuert wird

  • Strukturiert Probleme lösen, Prozesse dokumentieren und verbessern

  • Arbeiten mit CRM und Planungstools im Alltag

  • Direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Ops-Team

Deine Aufgaben:

Kundentelefon & Kundenanliegen

  • Anrufe und Anfragen von Kundinnen und Kunden annehmen, einordnen und lösen oder an die richtige Stelle weitergeben
  • Kundenanliegen sauber dokumentieren und bis zum Abschluss nachhalten
  • Technische Themen verständlich erklären, bei Bedarf mit Rücksprache unserer Techniker

Wartungskoordination

  • Wartungstermine mit Kundinnen und Kunden sowie unseren Hubs planen und bestätigen
  • Einsatzplanung der Hubs im Blick behalten, damit keine Wartung durchrutscht
  • Nachbereitung: Rückmeldungen einholen, offene Punkte klären

Serviceprozesse verbessern

  • Wiederkehrende Anfragen und Engpässe erkennen und Lösungen vorschlagen
  • Vorlagen, FAQs und Abläufe für den Operations aufbauen und pflegen
  • Learnings aus dem Kundenservice gebündelt an Ops Excellence und unser Product-Team weitergeben


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast gern Kundenkontakt und bleibst auch bei komplexen Themen freundlich und lösungsorientiert
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise – bei dir geht kein Termin verloren
  • Lust darauf, Abläufe nicht nur abzuarbeiten, sondern besser zu machen
  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau
  • Verfügbarkeit von mindestens 15 Std./Woche, verteilt auf feste Tage im Office in München
Von Vorteil:
  • Erste Erfahrung im Startup
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Kundenkontakt
  • Interesse an der Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeit
Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem – uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als eine vollständige Checkliste.


Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Echte Verantwortung und Entwicklung: Wir haben schon viele Werkis übernommen ;)
  • Direkte Wirkung: Deine Prozessverbesserungen gelten für alle Hubs
  • Einblick in ein schnell wachsendes Climate-Tech-Startup und in die Praxis der Wärmewende
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach deinem Semesterplan richten
  • Möglichkeit, Praxisprojekte oder Abschlussarbeiten bei uns zu schreiben
  • Direkter Kontakt zur Führungsebene
  • Top Büro im Glockenbach


Klingt nach dir?

Dann bewirb dich direkt über das Formular auf dieser Seite. Ein Lebenslauf reicht aber ein paar Sätze dazu, warum dich die Rolle reizt, freuen uns natürlich. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder Lebensweg, und melden uns zeitnah bei dir.
Du hast Kinder, pflegst Angehörige oder suchst aus anderen Gründen eine Stelle mit weniger Stunden, zum Beispiel 80 %? Bewirb dich trotzdem und sprich das gern direkt an – wir schauen gemeinsam, was möglich ist.

title: Marketing Director (m/w/d)
description:
Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you.

Exolaunch, headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in the U.S., France, and Japan, is a global leader in launch mission integration and deployment technologies for small satellites. With a decade of flight heritage and over 841 satellites launched across 49 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. Exolaunch fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.


Brand presence and consistent messaging are essential enablers of our success.  As the Marketing Director (m/w/d) at Exolaunch, you will serve as a core strategic leader driving our global marketing, brand presence, and multi-channel social media accounts, while exercising hands-on ownership of our public image, press relations, and executive communications.


We’re looking for a visionary marketing leader and creative storyteller with deep expertise in luxury branding, premium positioning, and high-impact copywriting. The ideal candidate brings an exceptional grasp of brand strategy and global communications, capable of converting complex technical achievements into compelling narratives for industry leaders, partners, and international media. As a senior strategist, you will lead brand governance, steer cross-functional marketing initiatives, and oversee data-driven performance analytics. You will be expected to quantify Return on Investment and Return on Effort across all campaigns to ensure Exolaunch remains top-of-mind in our industry. You will lead a small but powerful and passionate internal communications team and manage external PR agencies and advisors as needed.


Strategic Marketing & Brand Leadership:

You will define and execute our end-to-end global marketing strategy, ensuring consistency of brand identity across digital platforms and industry events. You will collaborate internally with all departments to translate technical innovation into flagship marketing campaigns while engaging externally with launch partners, customers, investors and other key stakeholders to solidify market awareness and top positioning.


Communications & Executive Media Relations:

You will lead execution of internal and external-facing communications activities, such as press releases, journalist inquiries, events (internal and external), and internal newsletters. This includes keeping company templates with boilerplate language, numbers, and figures current, fielding interview requests and coordinating conference and other public speaking engagements for staff, enforcing launch provider guidelines for external communications from our customers, and coordinating press releases intended for public release.


Please provide a portfolio of your previous work with your application. This is a full-time, 12 month contract, based in Berlin, with renewal option at end of contract.


Your mission

  • Execute an integrated communication strategy that aligns with the company's objectives and values. 

  • Serve as a company spokesperson and manage media relations, proactively seeking opportunities for media coverage and managing crisis communication as needed. Craft compelling messages that further refines Exolaunch’s brand voice, style, and tone.

  • Oversee and implement the creation and approval of press releases, articles, blog posts, social media content, and other communication materials. 

  • Provide direction on social graphics and digital campaigns through a passion for photography/videography/graphic design.

  • (Internal) Collaborate cross-functionally with departments such as engineering, mission management, and business development to ensure consistent messaging and alignment. 

  • (External) Collaborate with satellite customers, launch providers, graphic designers, internal technical personnel, and others to create and distribute compelling messaging.

  • Lead and support company and industry events including launch viewings, customer events, conferences, etc. in Europe, the US, and globally.

  • Build and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including industry influencers, journalists, and partners. 

  • Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify communication opportunities and risks. 

  • Stay up-to-date and forecast social trends, capitalizing on interesting cultural moments and tying them into a cohesive social strategy for an inherently technical organization.


Your profile

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in strategic marketing, global brand management, and high-level communications.

  • Proven expertise in luxury branding, premium product positioning, and hands-on brand ownership within high-tech, aerospace, or premium enterprise sectors.

  • Fluency and mastery of the English language with exceptional executive copywriting and storytelling capabilities.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field. Real-world experience may be substituted based on past performance.

  • Demonstrated track record of directing complex digital campaigns, media relations strategies, and high-profile global industry events.

  • Strong analytical capability to evaluate marketing ROI, campaign performance metrics, and market trends to drive business growth.

  • Practical understanding of online journalism, blogging, and social media

  • A grasp on vocabulary and concepts in the space and satellite industry, or can quickly learn them

  • A strong love for space/science/technology and willingness to learn the industry, inside and out


Why us?

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities

  • Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility

  • Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere

  • State-of-the-art office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz

  • Access to an in-house fitness studio at the HQ

  • All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively

  • Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment

  • Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events

  • Office-based position in a friendly, collaborative atmosphere


How to apply

Please apply directly via our careers page and select the relevant position:

  • https://www.exolaunch.com/careers

Please note that applications via email will not be considered. To ensure your application is linked to the correct position in our recruitment system, please apply directly via our careers page. 

Due to the high volume of applications, our review process may take some time. While we carefully consider all profiles, we may not be able to provide an individual update at every stage of the process. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer Energy (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Die Rolle

Wir bauen eine KI-Plattform für die Energiewirtschaft. Unsere Agenten unterstützen Prozesse wie Lieferantenwechsel, Netzanschluss, Abrechnung und Messstellenbetrieb.

Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer übernimmst Du einen Use Case von Discovery bis Go-Live. Du arbeitest direkt mit Fachbereichen bei Stadtwerken und Energieversorgern, verstehst ihre Prozesse und übersetzt dieses Wissen in produktive KI-Agenten.

Dabei verbindest Du GenAI Engineering mit Kundenarbeit: Du führst Fachinterviews und Workshops, entwickelst mit Python, LLMs, RAG und Tools funktionierende Lösungen und stellst durch systematische Evaluation sicher, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig funktionieren.

Aufgaben

  • Workshops und Fachinterviews durchführen und komplexe Prozesse sowie implizites Wissen verstehen
  • Anforderungen in Agent Blueprints und technische Lösungen übersetzen
  • KI-Agenten mit LLMs, RAG, Tool Use / Function Calling und Agenten-Orchestrierung entwickeln
  • Dokumente, Daten und Wissen für Retrieval und Agenten aufbereiten
  • Innerhalb weniger Tage funktionierende Prototypen entwickeln und mit Nutzern iterieren
  • Golden Questions, Testsets und Regressionstests zur Evaluation aufbauen
  • Feedback analysieren und Agenten kontinuierlich verbessern
  • Technische Möglichkeiten und Grenzen verständlich gegenüber Kunden kommunizieren
  • Wiederverwendbare Komponenten gemeinsam mit unserem Plattformteam weiterentwickeln

Das Team

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Plattform- und Delivery-Team aus AI und Software Engineering sowie Consulting zusammen. Lösungen entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – wiederverwendbare Komponenten und Erkenntnisse fließen zurück in unsere Plattform.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Praktische Erfahrung im GenAI Engineering, idealerweise mindestens 1–2 Jahre
  • Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Tool Use und Agenten-Orchestrierung
  • Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse auf Produktionsniveau
  • Erfahrung mit der Evaluation von GenAI-Anwendungen, z. B. Testsets, Golden Questions oder Regressionstests
  • Verständnis von Chunking, Retrieval, Metadaten und Wissensstrukturen
  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, unklare Anforderungen selbstständig zu strukturieren
  • Hohe Ownership und pragmatischer Umgang mit wechselnden Anforderungen
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher

Für uns zählen gebaute Anwendungen mehr als Zertifikate. Eigene Projekte, GitHub-Repositories oder andere Arbeitsproben sehen wir uns deshalb besonders gerne an.

Nice-to-have

  • Energiewirtschaftliches Know-how, z. B. Marktkommunikation, GPKE, EDIFACT, SAP IS-U oder kVASy
  • BPMN oder vergleichbare Prozessmodellierung
  • GCP, Docker und CI/CD
  • Knowledge Graphs oder strukturierte Wissensrepräsentation
  • Erfahrung aus Consulting oder anderen kundenorientierten technischen Rollen

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Erfolgsbeteiligung und Perspektive auf VSOPs
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-first-Arbeitsmodell
  • Standorte bzw. Smartoffice rund um Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet/NRW und München
  • Direkter Kontakt zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider
  • Frühe Verantwortung und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Modernes GenAI-Umfeld mit Fokus auf produktive AI Agents
  • Wertschätzendes Team und kurze Entscheidungswege

Wir suchen Mid-Level- und Senior-Profile.

Auf Mid-Level übernimmst Du eigene Use Cases von Discovery bis Go-Live. Auf Senior-Level entwickelst Du zusätzlich Standards und Blueprints für unser Agent Building weiter, arbeitest auf Kundenleitungsebene und hilfst uns, Forward Deployed Engineering im Team zu skalieren.

description:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.

Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.

Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.

Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.

Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.

Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und Prozessbeobachtung herausarbeiten – auch wenn Prozesse bisher kaum dokumentiert sind
  • Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
  • Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
  • Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen
  • Prozessdiagramme, Fachkonzepte, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Präsentationen erstellen
  • Stakeholder-Kommunikation und Erwartungsmanagement für Deine Use Cases übernehmen
  • Business Cases sowie KI-, Datenschutz- und Data-Governance-Freigaben beim Kunden begleiten
  • Fachliche Grundlagen für Scoping, Aufwandsschätzungen und Angebote erarbeiten
  • Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte nachhalten sowie Blocker sichtbar machen und vorantreiben
  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team prüfen, wie Lösungen auf weitere Fachbereiche oder Länder skaliert werden können

Das heutige Team

Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Delivery-Team mit Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering sowie Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Projekterfahrung in Business Analyse, Prozessberatung, Requirements Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Modellierung von Prozessen und Entscheidungslogiken, idealerweise mit BPMN
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Datenflüsse: Du kannst Objekte, Beziehungen, Quellen und Schlüssel herausarbeiten und nachvollziehen, was mit Daten in einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten passiert
  • Grundverständnis für KI und KI-gestützte Automatisierung, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenqualität, Ergebnisqualität und der Grenzen nicht-deterministischer Systeme
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Ownership: Du bringst Themen auch ohne Weisungsbefugnis voran und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder sicher abholen
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch fließend

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Daten-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit Legacy- oder Shadow-IT-Ablösungen
  • Erfahrung in regulierten oder Governance-intensiven Enterprise-Umgebungen
  • Agile Delivery-Modelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sowie Azure DevOps oder Jira
  • Kenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur, Vertragsmanagement oder Rechnungsprüfung
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Google Cloud oder vergleichbaren Datenplattformen

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung
  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung und Entwicklung in Richtung Data & AI
  • Firmenevents & Company Offsites
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet und München
  • Auswahl aus verschiedenen Benefits, z. B. Gym Pass oder Deutschlandticket
  • Direkter Zugang zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider beim Kunden
  • Die Möglichkeit, technisch tiefer in Daten, KI und Automatisierung einzusteigen als in vielen klassischen Beratungsrollen

Wir suchen bewusst jemanden auf Mid-Level. Du musst nicht alles am ersten Tag mitbringen. Wichtig sind Prozess- und Datenverständnis, technisches Interesse und die Bereitschaft, tiefer einzusteigen.

Bei uns kannst Du Dich Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln: vom Lesen von Datenflüssen zum Verstehen von Code, vom Datenverständnis zum eigenständigen Prüfen mit einfachen SQL-Abfragen oder Skripten und von klassischer Prozessmodellierung hin zu KI-gestützter Analyse und Automatisierung.

So kannst Du zunehmend tiefer in Data, AI und intelligente Prozessautomatisierung einsteigen, ohne Deine Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie aufzugeben.

Bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns Dich kennenzulernen!
